title: 第17章 以后少喝点第18章 连胜六十场惊动副阁主
content_zh:
“战天塔挑战的画面，会通过法阵传送到观玄阁的大厅中，身处大厅的游客可以实时观看挑战过程，公子若有不便展示的功法、武技和法宝，请自行权衡。”
在侍女的提醒下，林玄转身望向大厅中央悬挂着的一个“灵镜法阵”。
此阵有四面朝向，每一面都展露着同样的画面，还有声音随之传出。
展示的画面，正是战天塔内的情况，此时，正有一个灰袍青年在里面战斗。
根据画面显示，那是战天塔的第三层。
能走到这一层，说明此人已经连胜了两场，正在挑战第三场。
入口之前，一名守卫提醒林玄，并跟他订下一个警示契约。
契约的内容，主要是提醒挑战者应有的风险，不要在能力不及的情况下盲目挑战。
“战天塔的挑战是有生命危险的，特别是那些不含感情的战斗傀儡，只要你还在战斗他们就不会停手，强行挑战生死自负，请公子务必谨记！”
“知道了！”
林玄签下了警示契约，然后走进了战天塔。
沿着阶梯向上攀登，准备进入战天塔的第一级时，上方突然传来一声不堪的怒吼。
“又输了，我不服，下次一定把你打败！”
紧接着，一个灰袍青年走了下来。
正是林玄在灵镜画面中看到的武者。
此人曾经是银榜第九十七名，因为被现在的层主击败，又不肯接受排名下滑，直接离开了银榜。
虽然暂时掉出了榜单，但接下来，他可以获得每月一次的直接挑战九十七名的机会，无需再浪费时间从最底层打起。
此人由上而下，来到战天塔一层，看到林玄，忍不住摇头。
“小兄弟这么年轻就要挑战战天塔吗，你是玄气境几层？”
“玄气境八层。”林玄说道。

这灰袍青年，比灵镜上看到的更加成熟，应该比林玄大了十几岁。
灰袍青年摇头一笑：“你应该不超十六岁吧，这个年纪也算不差了，但战天塔的难度超乎想象，你的实力还不够，尽力就好，千万别勉强！”
灰袍青年向林玄投来同情的眼神，仿佛在提前安慰他的失败。
林玄没有多说什么，与灰袍青年擦肩而过，转身走进了战天塔第一层。
“银榜第九十九名，熊烈，玄气境九层！”
对面站着一个身材粗壮的武者，比林玄高出两头，胳膊比林玄的大腿还粗。
仿佛一个巨人在俯视林玄，看起来极具冲击力。
不过他的脸色有些冷淡，眼睛里面还散发着凌厉之气。
“林玄，玄气境八层！”
“玄气境八层？”
听到林玄报出的境界，熊烈大为不屑！
没搞错吧，这种实力也敢上战天塔？
content_en:
"The scene of the Battle Tower challenge will be transmitted to the hall of Guanxuan Pavilion through the magic circle. Visitors in the hall can watch the challenge process in real time. If you have any skills, martial arts or magic weapons that are inconvenient to display, please weigh them yourself."
At the reminder of the maid, Lin Xuan turned and looked at a "spiritual mirror array" hanging in the center of the hall.
This formation has four sides, and each side shows the same picture, and sounds follow it.
The picture displayed was exactly what was happening inside the Battle Tower. At this time, a young man in gray robe was fighting inside.
According to the screen, it was the third floor of the Battle Tower.
Being able to reach this level means that this person has won two games in a row and is challenging for the third game.
Before the entrance, a guard reminded Lin Xuan and made a warning contract with him.
The content of the contract is mainly to remind challengers of the risks they should take, and not to blindly challenge if they are unable to do so.
"The challenge in the Battle Tower is life-threatening, especially those battle puppets without emotions. As long as you are still fighting, they will not stop. They forcefully challenge life and death. Please remember this!"
"Got it!"
Lin Xuan signed the warning contract and walked into the Battle Tower.
Climbing up the stairs and preparing to enter the first level of the Battle Tower, an unbearable roar suddenly came from above.
"I lost again. I don't accept it. I will definitely defeat you next time!"
Immediately afterwards, a young man in gray robe walked down.
It was the warrior Lin Xuan saw in the spiritual mirror.
This person was once ranked ninety-seven on the silver list. Because he was defeated by the current floor leader and refused to accept the decline in ranking, he left the silver list directly.
Although he has temporarily fallen off the list, he will get a chance to directly challenge the ninety-seventh place once a month, and there is no need to waste time starting from the bottom.
This person came down from the top to the first floor of the Battle Tower. When he saw Lin Xuan, he couldn't help but shake his head.
"Little brother, do you want to challenge the Battle Tower at such a young age? What level of Xuanqi realm are you at?"
"The eighth level of Xuanqi Realm." Lin Xuan said.
This young man in gray robe is more mature than what he saw on the spiritual mirror. He should be more than ten years older than Lin Xuan.
The young man in gray robe shook his head and smiled: "You should be no more than sixteen years old. You are not bad at this age, but the difficulty of the Battle Tower is beyond imagination. You are not strong enough. Just try your best. Don't force it!"
The young man in gray robe cast a sympathetic look at Lin Xuan, as if to comfort him in advance for his failure.
Lin Xuan didn't say much, passed by the gray-robed young man, turned around and walked into the first floor of the Battle Tower.
"Ninety-nine on the Silver List, Xiong Lie, ninth level of Xuanqi Realm!"
Opposite him stood a stout warrior, two heads taller than Lin Xuan, with arms thicker than Lin Xuan's thighs.
It was as if a giant was looking down at Lin Xuan, which looked very impressive.
However, his face was a little cold, and his eyes still exuded a sharp aura.
"Lin Xuan, eighth level of Xuan Qi Realm!"
"Eighth level of Xuanqi realm?"
Xiong Lie was very disdainful when he heard the state reported by Lin Xuan!
Is that right? With this kind of strength, you dare to go to the Battle Tower?
